facts.value: ASU CEP tuition is offered at a reduced rate regardless of residency status.
Students have access to online ASU Libraries, career services, disability resources, military support, online tutoring and writing center, the student success center and more.
As an ASU student, you’ll have exceptional opportunities to meet new people, travel to far away places, explore new subjects and discover all that learning has to offer.
You can enjoy professional sporting events, arts and culture, and outdoor life, while taking advantage of the close proximity to major employers.
ASU and the Phoenix area really do have it all.
You can estimate your total cost using ASU's cost of attendance calculator.
ASU offers merit-based scholarships for international first-year and transfer students. You are automatically considered when you apply for admission — no separate application is needed.
Contact ASU’s International Students and Scholars Center at 480-727-4776 for more information or to discuss your particular circumstances.
As a graduate student, you'll pay ASU for tuition and fees. Some programs charge differential or program-specific tuition, which is in addition to the base tuition.
Housing and meals, books and supplies, transportation, and personal expenses will vary depending on your spending choices, and should be budgeted into your expenses.
Once you have received your I-20, be sure to pay your I-901 fee.
